Final green head for L1 (2026-11-25T03:41Z): `fd2011e516147f382f234389b342a118e7fc9f56`.

- Checks at this head: 40 `success` and 15 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state: clean`. The PR-body guards re-ran after this body edit (signature first line; item 2 now points to #37197).
- Size: 15 files, +503 / −78; no governed path. Part of #37150, items 1, 3 and 4; #37150 stays open for item 2, which #37197 carries (the maintainer ruled B, design first).
- Zone pre-read: from 768 px up, `/apps/APP/docs…` mounts `ConsoleLayout` with no top bar (`phoneDocsPage ? undefined : (…)`). The sidebar keeps its head and foot, and its body is the docs column via the new `sidebarDocsNavSlot` portal. `DocPage` drops its in-page nav when the sidebar carries it. The phone is unchanged.
- Evidence: two ablations went red as expected: the ConsoleLayout switch (desktop test red, phone control green) and the DocPage nav (9 red: the one-column test and all 8 URL-form pins). There are 8 pins on old URL forms. The stale `ConsoleLayout.noTopBar-36112` pin of the old docs top bar was corrected. There are six screenshots on `claude/issue-37150-screenshots` (da446f108).
- Points for L1: the full app-shell and console suites were narrowed locally (declared; the dev stopped them after 38 minutes on the shared lock), so CI Test UI is the full run. Browser reach is from the dev's screenshots, not a fresh seat run. If the maintainer picks "「全部文档」 first in both sidebars" for #37197 open question (2), this PR's sidebar (which has 「全部文档」 at the foot today) changes too, either before it lands or in #37197 stage 2.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `fd2011e516147f382f234389b342a118e7fc9f56` · 2026-11-25T03:53Z

The rework is to the PR body only. The code, tests and changeset are ready to accept at this head. Editing the body does not move the head, so the check-runs below stay valid.

**Checklist**
- **Shape (l1-face CLEAN, 13/13):**
  - draft, base `main`, `Part of #37150`, and no closing keyword;
  - no releases path; no `+0/-0` files; dogfood not owed;
  - the one published package touched (`@object-ui/console`) has a changeset;
  - `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Check-runs at head:** 55 runs: 40 success, 15 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending.
  - The floors `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both succeeded.
  - `Test UI` ran in affected mode on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: 3217 files in 9 of 16 slots, with 3216 passed and 1 skipped. All five touched test files ran green: phoneRecordOneBar 15, noTopBar 8, footerSlot 5, BootShell 7 and docs-portal 66.
- **K = 12.**
  - Merge base `95734fef7`; `origin/main` is at `a33691e56`.
  - `merge-tree` against main is clean, and main's only drift on this surface (`designMode.tsx`, #37085) is unrelated.
- **Item 1 (desktop app shell):**
  - Code:
    - `ConsoleLayout.tsx:206,290,295,307,359`;
    - `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:843` (body swap);
    - the new `sidebarDocsNavSlot.tsx`;
    - `DocShell.tsx:60` (portal) and `:65` (header row);
    - `DocPage.tsx:397`;
    - `ConsoleBootShell.tsx:94,109`.
  - Tests that go red on revert:
    - `phoneRecordOneBar-28483:241` (768/1440 × 5 paths: sidebar present, `data-docs-nav`, 0 headers);
    - `noTopBar-36112:109`;
    - `footerSlot-36739:235`;
    - `docs-portal:1006/1019/1040`;
    - `ConsoleBootShell-35981` at 768/1440.
  - The two ablations agree: `1 failed | 14 passed`, and 9 red.
- **Item 3 (old links):**
  - No route or `isAppDocsPath` change: `AppContent.tsx` docs routes and `App.tsx` `/docs` are not in the diff, and nothing is redirected or dropped.
  - 8 URL forms are pinned in the shell (`docs-portal:1027`, `:1070`). Each asserts the landing path, the article body and a single column. Ablation 2 reddened all 8.
  - `/apps/crm/docs/` and the flat permalink are added to the frame pin.
- **Item 4 (phone):** every new branch is gated on `phone`.
  - The slot hooks return null on a phone.
  - No sidebar means a null slot, so the in-page column and the back bar stay.
  - Pinned by:
    - `phoneRecordOneBar:254` PHONE CONTROL (390 × 5 paths, one header);
    - `noTopBar:109` (the 390 leg);
    - BootShell at 375;
    - `docs-portal:1084`.
- **`/docs…` untouched:** `DocsPortalRoute`, `HomeLayout` and `AppHeader` are not in the diff.
  - The shared `DocShell`/`DocPage` branches are inert there, because the provider and the `ShellPageActionsScope` are mounted only by `ConsoleLayout`.
  - `usePackageDocsNavBooks` is an exact lift of the old memo, reading the same `useBookData().docs`.
  - The existing `/docs` pins are unchanged and green.
- **i18n vs `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`:** no locale file in the diff, and **no key removed or renamed.**
  - The keys used are `help.docsNavigation`, `help.documentation`, `help.uncategorized` and `help.allDocs`. No new key.
  - `help.docsNavigation` postdates 18.6.0 (#36000) and is already used on main with a `defaultValue`.
- **Published exports and types: no change.**
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. Its root exports gain additively: the 4 slot symbols, plus `useShellPageActionsSlot` and `useShellSidebarExpandSlot`.
  - `@object-ui/console` publishes only `plugin.ts`/`plugin.d.ts` and the SPA `dist`, and `plugin.ts` is untouched.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold, in both the PR body and the changeset. Nothing published is widened, and no spec or metadata key changes.
- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence:** it is in user terms, and each sentence matches the code.
  - "page header's button group (assistant and help)" matches `ShellPageActionsGroup` (`AssistantTopBarButton` + `HelpMenu`).
  - "The reader no longer draws that column inside the page there" matches `DocPage:397`.
  - "other docs pages … carry the same column in the sidebar instead of a back link" matches `DocShell:60,70`.
  - "every docs address resolves … phone … `/docs` not changed" matches items 3 and 4 and the portal check above.
- **Local narrowing:** acceptable.
  - The full app-shell and console suites the dev stopped locally did run at this head in CI `Test UI`: the affected set holds both packages' whole suites (2443 + 335 files) plus 437 always-on files.
  - The PR body's local readings at `827b3c75a` and `2ec431259` are not at the head, so they are not counted. CI at the head covers the same files.
- **Browser evidence:** 5 screenshots are linked on `claude/issue-37150-screenshots` (`da446f108`), and all resolve.
  - They were taken at `096ac6732`. Since then the only implementation-file drift is the changeset line and 3 `index.ts` lines from the main merge.
  - The desktop reader shot shows no top bar, a head with 「Showcase」, search and bell, a body from 「← Back to Showcase」 to 「All documentation」, and the account foot. The portal still has its bar, and the phone control keeps its bar and the in-page disclosure.
- **Overlap:**
  - #37166 shares only `app-shell/src/index.ts`, in disjoint hunks; `merge-tree` is clean.
  - #37204 shares no file and is clean. Its desktop `AppHeader` label no longer reaches app docs pages, which now draw no `AppHeader`. Nothing is lost.
  - #37197 is a sequential dependency (stage 2 is blocked on this PR and reuses `sidebarDocsNavSlot`), not a conflict.

**Open**
- S1 (should-fix) — The 维护者速读 line 4 is stale. It asks 「需要你定一件事：独立文档门户…侧栏顶部该显示哪个应用，或不显示应用」. The maintainer already ruled B at 2026-11-25T03:13Z (#37150 comment 7151721568), with design first (7151737403). #37197 carries it, as this body's own first paragraph says.
  - Rewrite line 4 to say no decision is owed on this PR, because the portal was ruled B and is carried by #37197.
  - Optionally name the one pending #37197 question that would change this PR: where 「全部文档」 sits.
  - This is a body edit only; no new head.
- N1 — Two hunks of item 1 are unpinned; a revert of either stays green.
  - `ConsoleLayout.tsx:369` now shows `ConnectionBanner` on desktop docs pages, where previously it was `!docsPage`. No docs-route test passes `connectionState: 'disconnected'`.
  - The docs header's expand button suppressing the corner fallback, claimed in Acceptance notes, has no collapsed-sidebar docs-route test.
  - One `noTopBar-36112` case each would pin them. Optional.
- N2 — Browser evidence is thinner than the captions suggest.
  - `desktop-app-docs-reader.png` and `desktop-app-docs-flat-permalink.png` are the same blob (`5a20b872`).
  - The "docs index" shot is the single-book redirect into the reader.
  - No shot shows the non-reader `AppDocsNav` column (a multi-book index or a not-found page). Tests cover it (`docs-portal:1040,1058`).

**Note for later (not graded):** suppose the maintainer answers #37197's 「全部文档」 question with B, first in both sidebars.
- This PR's sidebar would then change at `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsNav.tsx:119-128`: the `<div className="border-t pt-3">` with `<Link to={allDocsHref} data-testid="docs-nav-all-docs">`, at the foot after the book list.
- It is shared by the reader (`DocPage.tsx:384-393`) and `AppDocsNav` (`DocsNav.tsx:181`).
- It also renders the phone in-page column, so the move needs a phone guard to keep item 4.
- It is pinned for presence only, not position (`docs-portal.test.tsx:1013`).

**Landing to-dos at ACCEPT:** `Part of #37150` does not auto-close the card. #37150 stays open for item 2 (#37197), and `pm:dispatched` on #37150 stays until #37197 lands (landing rule B).

- **S1: closed.** 维护者速读 line 4 no longer asks the maintainer to choose the `/docs` frame. It says the frame was ruled B (7151721568), that #37197 carries it, and that #37197's only open point affecting this PR is where 「全部文档」 sits in the sidebar.
- **N1, N2: deferred to #37197 stage 2.** The zone has recorded them there:
  - two pins: the docs-page `ConnectionBanner`, and the collapsed sidebar's expand button;
  - a screenshot of the non-reader `AppDocsNav`;
  - a phone guard at `DocsNav.tsx:119-128`.
- **Everything else in 7152350994 stands.**
  - Items 1, 3 and 4 are mapped and pinned.
  - Every `/apps/APP/docs…` URL form is unchanged.
  - `/docs…` is untouched.
  - No i18n or export movement.
  - 40 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed.
  - K = 12.
- **Landing.** This PR is not Tier H, so zone a4-C lands it. It is "Part of #37150"; that card stays open for #37197.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
